editorial.blurb: Moonbowls serves vibrant Korean bowls with customizable options and fresh ingredients, though recent visits suggest quality consistency has wavered.
editorial.insiderTip: Build your own bowl to control freshness and sauce application — several reviewers praise the Korean BBQ cauliflower when made properly with their vegan ranch sauce, so specify you want it saucy and well-seasoned.
signatureDishes: Korean BBQ cauliflower with vegan ranch sauce
